newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2 bln for week of Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2 bln for week of Feb 18.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for the week of February 18 are tentatively expected to total $2 billion in 95 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $476 million in 53 sales. The largest is a $65 Arlington Independent School District, Texas, issue on February 20.
Negotiated sales total $1.5 billion in 42 offerings. The largest is a $247 million Hempstead Industrial Development Authority, N.Y., offering through Smith Barney inc.
